news.api.views

REST API endpoints for news content and subscriptions.

Endpoints apply authentication and role-based permissions before returning or changing application data.

Classes

ApprovedArticleAPIView

Internal endpoint used by the approval workflow to log approvals.

ArticleDetailAPIView

Retrieve, update, or delete one article.

ArticleListCreateAPIView

List approved articles or submit a new article.

NewsletterListCreateAPIView

List newsletters or create a new one.

PublisherListAPIView

List publishers.

SubscribedArticleListAPIView

List approved articles from the reader's subscriptions.

UserListAPIView

List users.

Bases: ListCreateAPIView

List approved articles or submit a new article.

  • GET /api/articles/ – any signed-in user.

  • POST /api/articles/ – journalists only.

serializer_class

alias of ArticleSerializer

get_permissions()[source]

Require a journalist for POST and any signed-in user otherwise.

get_queryset()[source]

Return approved articles only.

class news.api.views.SubscribedArticleListAPIView(**kwargs)[source]

List approved articles from the reader’s subscriptions.

  • GET /api/articles/subscribed/ – readers only.

serializer_class

alias of ArticleSerializer

get_queryset()[source]

class news.api.views.ArticleDetailAPIView(**kwargs)[source]

Bases: RetrieveUpdateDestroyAPIView

Retrieve, update, or delete one article.

  • GET /api/articles/<pk>/ – any signed-in user (approved articles only).

  • PUT/PATCH/DELETE – editors, or journalists for their own independent articles. A journalist’s update sends the article back for approval.

serializer_class

alias of ArticleSerializer

get_queryset()[source]

Return all articles, limited to approved ones for read requests.

get_permissions()[source]

Require an editor or journalist for changes, sign-in for reads.

get_object()[source]

Return the article, checking ownership for changes.

Raises:

rest_framework.exceptions.PermissionDenied – If a journalist tries to change an article they do not own (403 Forbidden).

perform_update(serializer)[source]

Save the update; a journalist’s change resets approved.

class news.api.views.ApprovedArticleAPIView(**kwargs)[source]

Bases: APIView

Internal endpoint used by the approval workflow to log approvals.

POST /api/approved/ with {"article_id": <id>} – editors only. Called by news.services.post_approved_article().

post(request)[source]

Create the log entry for an approved article.

Returns:

201 with the new log entry, 200 if it already existed, 400 if article_id is missing or not an integer, or 404 if no approved article has that ID.

Return type:

rest_framework.response.Response
